title: Add OIDC-primary sign-in with existing-account SMTP magic links
description: Keep OIDC as the only account-creation path. Add opt-in SMTP magic links for existing OIDC-linked users, separate 24-hour magic-link and finite OIDC session limits, and a polished provider-first login UI with configurable provider branding.
acceptance_criteria: No magic-link signup or unlinked-account access; links are single-use and short-lived; session expiry enforced server-side; SMTP is optional and secret-backed; login UI offers OIDC first and email second; tests and deployment docs cover behavior.
close_reason: Implemented with OIDC-only account creation, SMTP magic link guard, 24-hour sessions, Magic UI login, and automated end-to-end tests

title: Add per-user item watchlists
description: Let authenticated users watch/unwatch individual catalog listings independently of saved filter views. Store owner, stable listing reference, createdAt, optional note and per-item notification preference; show watched state, watchlist filter, and a compact watchlist page. No notification delivery in this issue.
acceptance_criteria: Watches survive restart, are owner-scoped, and remain stable across new observations; users can browse watched items without constructing a saved search; tests cover authorization and deletion.
close_reason: Implemented, covered by build/typecheck and 82 tests; production deployment verified healthy

title: Add manual research editor and authenticated agent API
description: Expose the same validated research submission/import service through a compact human editor, JSON paste, and a documented API for code agents. Agent access uses revocable, scoped credentials (or provider-neutral OIDC service credentials), not browser cookies or shared operator secrets. Keep authorship/provenance and revisions; alternate entry modes never bypass validation or authorization.
acceptance_criteria: Equivalent research submitted manually, by JSON paste, or through API yields the same normalized records and evidence links; tests cover credential scope, auth, validation, revisions, and idempotency.
close_reason: Implemented and verified with tests

title: Define editable market-comparable research baseline
description: Extend the versioned provider-neutral research contract with structured market evidence: marketplace/channel as data, active asking vs completed sale vs retail offer, item/shipping price, currency, condition, observed/sold time, source URL/citation, sample size/window for summaries, confidence, and freeform notes. Use the same validated write model for manual entry, pasted JSON, and agent API; preserve actor, timestamps, raw input, and revisions. Avoid hardcoding eBay/Amazon into core enums.
acceptance_criteria: Schema tests cover manual/JSON/API-equivalent validation, provenance, partial submissions, and immutable references; active asking is never conflated with sold price; computed summaries are deterministic.
close_reason: Implemented, covered by build/typecheck and 82 tests; production deployment verified healthy

title: Serve cached photos and hover previews
description: Add authenticated same-origin media routes. Use cached thumbnail in listing cells and accessible hover/focus preview at the same resolution used on details. Show explicit uncached state without silently contacting external CDNs; expose capture status and operator backfill control.
acceptance_criteria: Browsing a fully cached list/detail makes no requests to the source CDN; missing cache does not trigger a browser-side source request; keyboard and touch users can reach preview/detail.
close_reason: Implemented, covered by build/typecheck and 82 tests; production deployment verified healthy

title: Build opt-in paced photo capture on the app worker
description: Use the in-process worker to capture only approved source-media URLs already in the catalog, with explicit operator activation and per-run ceilings. Validate HTTPS hosts and redirects to prevent SSRF; respect access controls; use identifiable requests, one-at-a-time pacing, Retry-After/backoff, timeout, response/decode size caps, MIME validation, metadata stripping, and clear partial/error progress. No dev or catalog-run auto-fetch.
acceptance_criteria: Fixture-backed tests cover rejection, pacing, ceilings, invalid images, dedupe, retry behavior, and resumable backfill; no live source calls in tests.
close_reason: Implemented, covered by build/typecheck and 82 tests; production deployment verified healthy

title: Model deduplicated photo derivatives in PostgreSQL
description: Add content-addressed media records and source-URL associations. Retain bounded thumbnail (~96px) and detail preview (~480px) bytes as bytea, checksum, MIME, dimensions, capturedAt, original URL, and failure state. Define per-image and aggregate storage limits and backup/restore tests.
acceptance_criteria: Migrations and tests cover deduplication, metadata/provenance, byte limits, and backup visibility; catalog list queries never select binary columns.
close_reason: Implemented, covered by build/typecheck and 82 tests; production deployment verified healthy

title: Capture and serve bounded source photos
description: Replace browser-to-source-CDN image loads with an operator-controlled, source-safe capture pipeline. Store deduplicated low-resolution thumbnail and detail derivatives in PostgreSQL initially; keep original URL and capture provenance. Do not add an object store without measured need.
acceptance_criteria: Captured images render from authenticated Hoardcore routes; normal catalog collection never fans out into image requests; backfill is paced, resumable, and disabled by default; dev does not fetch automatically; backup/restore includes media.
close_reason: Implemented with opt-in safety controls and verified in production container

title: Save reusable listing filters
description: Persist versioned, user-owned listing filter configurations with price and compare-at discount ranges. Reuse a pure matching contract for future notifications. Do not send notifications yet.
acceptance_criteria: Users can save, load, and delete named filter views; price and discount filters are validated and applied consistently; saved views survive restart; authorization is server-enforced.
close_reason: Implemented, integration-tested, and deployed to dev and production

title: Make tracker routes and surfaces dense
description: Fix list/detail route nesting, replace narrative headers with compact controls throughout the authenticated app, make listings nearly full-width and dense, reorder columns, show short observed dates, and add useful search/category/manufacturer/source/availability filters with pagination.
acceptance_criteria: Detail links render detail; table is dense and near full width; fields appear in requested order; filters work over current listings; authenticated pages use compact task-focused headers.
close_reason: Implemented, tested, and deployed to dev and production

title: Expose catalog evidence fields in the tracker
description: Persist Shopify compare-at price as a generic listing price field with observation history, backfill from retained evidence where possible, and expose already-stored manufacturer, merchant product type, image URL, and availability in the current tracker. Do not infer stock quantity from availability.
acceptance_criteria: Existing completed runs show compare-at prices without recontacting sources; current and historical records preserve comparison price; tracker shows manufacturer/category/image/availability; source-neutral core contracts remain generic.
close_reason: Implemented, tested, and deployed to dev and production

title: Accept blank optional Shopify catalog fields
description: A Shopify collection page contained an empty product_type; strict optional-field validation rejected the page. Normalize blank/null optional metadata while keeping identity fields strict. On a later malformed page, retain prior valid pages as a marked partial snapshot and preserve the rejected raw page as evidence. No live store requests were used to test the fix.
acceptance_criteria: Blank and null optional product/variant metadata parse safely; required title/handle/id/variants still reject malformed values; later malformed pages retain valid earlier pages as partial with diagnostic evidence; offline and database tests, build, CI, and deployment health pass.
close_reason: Fixed optional Shopify metadata parsing and partial-page salvage; 59 tests, build, CI, and dev/prod readiness passed.

title: Expose bounded manual collection budgets and live run progress
description: A collection exceeding its conservative request ceiling used to fail silently and lose useful pages. Let an authenticated operator choose a bounded per-run ceiling, inspect persisted progress/events, and distinguish running in background from watching live. Retain incomplete pages as explicitly partial observations without inferring absence. Do not automatically increase pressure or retry source failures.
acceptance_criteria: Per-run ceiling is validated and shown; progress/events are persisted and watchable; ceiling completion is marked partial with page and product counts; collection remains paced, bounded, and fail-closed; source failures do not auto-retry; offline tests and build pass.
close_reason: Implemented bounded per-run budget, partial snapshots, persisted live progress, and terminal job behavior; verified and deployed to dev/prod.

title: Add research history to tracker detail
description: Expose research batches, runs, normalized results, evidence, risks, and prior versions from product/listing detail surfaces.
acceptance_criteria: An operator can identify when and how a result was created, inspect evidence and prior research, and distinguish research claims from collected source observations.
close_reason: Implemented and verified with tests

title: Persist raw and normalized research with evidence
description: Persist the original structured payload and normalized research fields, citations/evidence, schema/prompt versions, timestamps, and immutable entity references without silently discarding provenance.
acceptance_criteria: Imports are auditable and idempotent where appropriate; raw payload remains available; normalized claims and citations attach to the intended product or variant.
close_reason: Implemented and verified with tests

title: Create research batches and copyable exports
description: Create a research batch from selected listings/products and render a copyable prompt plus structured packet suitable for external chat/research tools.
acceptance_criteria: Selections retain immutable references; exports are deterministic and versioned; the UI supports copying prompt and packet without invoking a model API.
close_reason: Implemented selected-listing research packet and prompt export using server-reloaded immutable Hoardcore references, with copyable provider-neutral UI.

title: Validate and preview pasted research results
description: Accept pasted JSON, parse it safely, reconcile immutable references, and show valid, partial, unknown, duplicate, and invalid records before any persistence mutation.
acceptance_criteria: Invalid input cannot mutate data; preview explains per-record outcomes; the operator explicitly confirms which importable records proceed.
close_reason: Implemented and verified with tests

title: Define versioned research packet and result contracts
description: Define provider-neutral Zod schemas for ResearchPacket and ResearchResult with immutable Hoardcore references, prompt/schema versions, source facts, normalized research fields, citations, risks, and partial-result diagnostics.
acceptance_criteria: Contracts round-trip through JSON, reject incompatible versions clearly, distinguish source facts from research claims, and contain no provider-specific fields.
close_reason: Added versioned provider-neutral Zod ResearchPacket/ResearchResult contracts with immutable entity references, source facts, claims, estimates, risks, citations, diagnostics, and round-trip/version/provenance tests.

title: Build provider-neutral research interchange
description: Let operators select tracked candidates, export immutable versioned research packets and prompts for any external research tool, then validate, preview, and persist structured results without coupling Hoardcore to an AI provider.
acceptance_criteria: An operator can select listings, generate a versioned copyable research packet, paste a versioned structured result, preview validation outcomes, import valid and partially valid records deliberately, and inspect raw payload, normalized research, citations, and history on the relevant product or variant.

title: Add listing detail, evidence, and change history
description: Add a listing detail surface that preserves source evidence and shows price/availability observation history without conflating observations with current normalized state.
acceptance_criteria: An operator can open a listing, identify its source reference, inspect current normalized fields, and review timestamped historical observations and retained evidence.
close_reason: Implemented operator run controls, current-listings tracker, listing detail, observation history, and retained evidence; tests and production build pass.

title: Validate documented container deployment
description: Exercise migrations, liveness/readiness checks, restart behavior, backup/restore documentation, and a conservative live collection against an operator-supplied source without encoding installation-specific infrastructure.
acceptance_criteria: A documented one-application-plus-PostgreSQL deployment migrates from empty state, survives restart, reports health/readiness accurately, has a tested backup/restore procedure, and completes one conservative collection against an operator-supplied source.

title: Build the current-listings tracker table
description: Present normalized current listings using TanStack Table with source, product, variant, price, availability, last observed time, and conservative search/filter/sort controls.
acceptance_criteria: After a successful fixture-backed or live collection, an operator can browse and filter current listings without querying PostgreSQL directly.
close_reason: Implemented operator run controls, current-listings tracker, listing detail, observation history, and retained evidence; tests and production build pass.

comments.author: formless63
comments.text: Implemented tracker slice: authenticated generic current-listings server function/query, TanStack Table v9 table with source/module/product/variant/SKU/price/availability/observed fields, search, sorting, stable links, semantic markup, and empty state. Build/typecheck/tests pass; closure awaits dependency hc-7xa.4.

title: Add operator-controlled collection runs
description: Provide a gated manual collection action, durable Graphile Worker execution, request-budget/pacing controls, and visible queued/running/succeeded/failed state.
acceptance_criteria: An authorized operator can start one collection, cannot accidentally fan out unbounded work, and can see run timestamps, request counts, status, and actionable errors.
close_reason: Implemented operator run controls, current-listings tracker, listing detail, observation history, and retained evidence; tests and production build pass.

title: Deliver the first usable catalog tracker
description: Turn persisted catalog snapshots into an operator-usable tracker: gated collection runs, current listing review, change history, and a deployable acceptance path. The milestone is usable when an operator can register a source, run a conservative collection, inspect normalized current state and evidence/history, and see failures without touching the database.
acceptance_criteria: A gated operator can register a Shopify collection source, trigger a conservative run, see run state/errors, review the resulting current listings, open listing history/evidence, and repeat a cached/paced run on dev and production deployments.

title: Persist catalog snapshots and observations
description:
Add migrations and persistence services for normalized current catalog state plus timestamped source observations/evidence, then wire the Shopify job without discarding history.

## Required Skills
hoardcore-module,safe-source-collection
acceptance_criteria: Repeated snapshots reconcile stable source listings, current state updates deterministically, observations retain price/availability evidence and timestamps, and restart-safe integration tests pass against PostgreSQL.
close_reason: Implemented and verified offline contracts, conservative transport, normalization, PostgreSQL snapshot persistence, observations, and run-level evidence; no live source requests.

title: Parse and normalize Shopify collection records
description:
Parse captured source-native collection responses and normalize products/listings/variants into generic Hoardcore contracts with stable identifiers and source facts kept distinct from inference.

## Required Skills
hoardcore-module,safe-source-collection
acceptance_criteria: Fixture-based parse and normalize tests cover valid, partial, and malformed records; platform response shapes remain under src/modules/shopify; generic domain models contain no Shopify-specific field names.
close_reason: Implemented and verified offline contracts, conservative transport, normalization, PostgreSQL snapshot persistence, observations, and run-level evidence; no live source requests.

title: Implement conservative Shopify fetch transport
description:
Implement identifiable, robots-aware Shopify HTTP acquisition with explicit concurrency, minimum pacing, total request ceiling, conditional caching, Retry-After, backoff, and stop-on-persistent-rejection. Do not implement evasion.

## Required Skills
hoardcore-module,safe-source-collection
acceptance_criteria: Transport policy is unit-tested with a fake HTTP boundary; one collection-level request path is preferred over product fan-out; rejection and request-ceiling cases stop cleanly; no live target is used in automated tests.
close_reason: Implemented and verified offline contracts, conservative transport, normalization, PostgreSQL snapshot persistence, observations, and run-level evidence; no live source requests.

title: Define Shopify collection fixture contracts
description:
Define source-native Zod schemas and sanitized synthetic fixtures for collection pages/catalog responses without embedding operator-specific domains or relying on live network access.

## Required Skills
hoardcore-module,safe-source-collection
acceptance_criteria: Fixtures cover pagination, variants, pricing, compare-at pricing, availability, stable product/variant identifiers, and malformed records; tests run entirely offline.
close_reason: Implemented and verified offline contracts, conservative transport, normalization, PostgreSQL snapshot persistence, observations, and run-level evidence; no live source requests.

title: Build conservative Shopify collection snapshots
description:
Implement the first real source-collection pipeline for generic Shopify storefront or collection scopes. Keep fetch, parse, normalize, and persist independent; use offline fixtures for repeated development; run live jobs only through in-process Graphile Worker.

## Required Skills
hoardcore-module,safe-source-collection
acceptance_criteria: A registered Shopify collection can produce a durable snapshot and observations through an operator-triggered job; source controls, robots policy, pacing, request ceiling, Retry-After, caching, and persistent-rejection stop behavior are enforced; tests do not require live storefront requests; no target-specific domains or selectors are committed.
close_reason: Conservative reusable Shopify snapshot pipeline verified with synthetic fixtures and PostgreSQL integration tests; live acceptance remains a deployment task.

title: Protect operator source workflows
description: Require authenticated sessions inside catalog-source server functions and present provider-neutral sign-in/session UI without relying on route hiding for authorization.
acceptance_criteria: Anonymous direct calls to list/create sources are rejected; signed-in operators can use existing workflows; authenticated responses are private/no-store; authorization tests pass.
close_reason: Added provider-neutral sign-in/sign-out UI, server-function private no-store headers, anonymous/authenticated authorization boundary tests, and retained reachable auth callback routes.

title: Embed Graphile Worker lifecycle
description: Run Graphile Worker in the application process with an explicit typed task registry, conservative concurrency, durable enqueue boundary, startup-once behavior, graceful shutdown, and readiness state.
acceptance_criteria: A fixture job can be enqueued, executed, and retained across restart; runner shutdown precedes database pool shutdown; one app container runs both web and worker duties; no separate worker service is added.
close_reason: Embedded worker now wired to Nitro server plugin: starts once at Nitro initialization, captures startup errors, and stops on Nitro close before database pool shutdown. Verified production build includes plugin and worker; focused fixture tests passed before concurrent dependency relink.

title: Add provider-neutral Better Auth OIDC
description: Implement Better Auth with the Drizzle adapter and generic OIDC configuration, committed auth migrations, session helpers, catch-all auth route, and server-side authorization middleware.
acceptance_criteria: OIDC configuration is validated as a complete unit; auth schema migrates from empty PostgreSQL; unauthenticated direct server-function/API calls cannot access private data; no hosted Hoardcore identity dependency exists.
close_reason: Implemented provider-neutral Better Auth OIDC foundation with Drizzle schema/migration, session helpers, catch-all route, and server-side auth enforcement.

comments.author: formless63
comments.text: Implemented lazy Better Auth + Drizzle adapter, generic OIDC config validation, auth schema migration, catch-all route, and requireSession helper. Source server functions now enforce auth. Verified tests/typecheck.

title: Complete authenticated job foundation
description: Finish the remaining foundation boundaries before live source collection: provider-neutral Better Auth/OIDC, server-side authorization, and an in-process Graphile Worker lifecycle with durable tasks and graceful shutdown.
acceptance_criteria: OIDC sessions protect private server functions/routes; auth tables migrate cleanly; Graphile Worker runs inside the application process, persists jobs in PostgreSQL, stops gracefully, and exposes useful readiness state; no separate worker service is introduced.
close_reason: OIDC auth schema, server-side authorization, embedded Graphile Worker lifecycle, readiness, and graceful shutdown verified in a production build/container.

title: Build catalog source registration workflow
description: Add generic source contracts and DB operations, typed server functions, /sources list, and /sources/new form using TanStack Form. Shopify is a module choice, not a core assumption.
acceptance_criteria: Operators can list sources, see an empty state, validate and register a Shopify storefront, and see persisted status after navigation/reload. Core UI and data names remain platform-neutral.
close_reason: Implemented capability-oriented Shopify registration, validated server functions, database persistence, duplicate handling, operational overview, /sources list, and TanStack Form /sources/new flow. Unit, integration, typecheck, build, and local route smoke checks pass.

title: Establish validated config and Drizzle persistence
description: Add server-only validated environment access, Drizzle schema/config, PostgreSQL pool boundary, committed initial migration, and migration/check commands.
acceptance_criteria: Missing or invalid config fails clearly; client code cannot import secrets; source schema migrates from empty PostgreSQL; migration metadata is committed; focused tests and typecheck pass.
close_reason: Validated config, pooled Drizzle boundary, initial catalog_sources migration, health/readiness endpoints, and migration checks implemented; fresh and repeated migrations passed against PostgreSQL 18.

title: Foundation: DB-backed source registration
description: Deliver the first real Hoardcore operator workflow: validated configuration, PostgreSQL/Drizzle migrations, generic catalog source persistence, and a TanStack Start sources UI. Collection, auth, and worker execution remain follow-on foundation work.
acceptance_criteria: A clean database can be migrated; an operator can list and register a Shopify source through the application; server boundaries validate input; production build and automated tests pass; docs describe the implemented state.
close_reason: First vertical slice complete: operators can register generic Shopify storefront or collection sources backed by PostgreSQL, with module-owned validation, operational UI, migrations, health checks, CI, docs, and container verification.

title: Validate SMTP magic-link delivery on an operator relay
description: After the operator supplies SMTP env values on an approved deployment, request a link for an existing OIDC account, verify delivery and 10-minute expiry, and confirm unknown addresses receive the same public response without mail.
acceptance_criteria: Live relay delivery works without exposing link or credentials in logs; OIDC sign-in remains usable; an unknown address does not receive mail.

title: Resolve source price currency before cross-source comparisons
description: Current public collection JSON provides numeric prices but no currency code. Add a validated source-level currency setting or supported source discovery, then scope cross-source price and discount comparisons accordingly. Do not silently assume USD.
acceptance_criteria: Price labels and saved-view matching never imply a currency that the source did not provide.

title: Surface imported research summaries in catalog review
description: After research import persists versioned runs, project concise latest market estimate, confidence, risk, and research status into optional listing columns and filters. Keep full claims/citations in detail/history, and deterministic ROI in the opportunity workflow.
acceptance_criteria: Users can choose relevant research columns without bloating the default tracker; values link to the underlying research run and evidence.
close_reason: Implemented and verified with tests

title: Retain and display multiple product image URLs
description: Store all source-provided image URLs in a generic product media model, backfill from retained evidence, and display a small detail gallery. Avoid downloading image binaries during collection.
acceptance_criteria: All provided product image URLs survive normalization and can be viewed without additional catalog requests.
close_reason: Implemented, integration-tested, and deployed to dev and production

title: Add opt-in ntfy alerts for saved views and watched items
description: After a new normalized observation is persisted, evaluate both saved filter views and per-user watched listings. Allow opt-in per rule/item and event type (new match, price/availability change); deliver through ntfy via the in-process worker with idempotency/dedupe, retries, and no source-site requests. Keep channel configuration and secrets operator-controlled.
acceptance_criteria: Notifications are opt-in, deduplicated per user/rule/listing/observation/event, and tested without a live ntfy service; failures do not fail catalog persistence.
close_reason: Implemented, covered by build/typecheck and 82 tests; production deployment verified healthy

title: Add operator collection defaults settings
description: Add a compact authenticated settings surface for installation-wide default manual collection request ceiling. Keep per-run overrides bounded and validated, and leave room for future operator settings without speculative infrastructure.
acceptance_criteria: An authenticated operator can view/change the default manual request ceiling; Sources and Overview use it for new run controls; each run stores its selected ceiling; validation prevents out-of-range values.
close_reason: Implemented, tested, and deployed to dev and production

title: Design resumable per-page pacing and operator continue
description: Consider an operator-configurable longer inter-page wait with a live countdown and a continue action. The action may skip discretionary wait only after the enforced minimum pacing period. Persist page checkpoints before long waits so app restarts cannot silently refetch pages or lose partial observations. Keep a finite request ceiling and respect source controls.
acceptance_criteria: A design and implementation provide durable progress across restart, an accurate wait countdown, a bounded continue action, and offline tests proving the request ceiling and minimum pacing cannot be bypassed.

title: Build opportunity ranking and filters
description: Add a table for review state, economics, confidence, demand, liquidity, and risk signals with transparent sorting and filtering.
acceptance_criteria: Operators can focus the queue by state and deterministic economics while retaining links to source evidence and research history.

title: Calculate profit, ROI, and break-even scenarios
description: Implement deterministic server/domain calculations for expected profit, ROI, margin, break-even price, and downside scenarios with tested rounding and missing-input behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Calculations are reproducible, unit-tested, never delegated to a model, and show which assumptions produced each result.

title: Model deterministic opportunity assumptions
description: Model quantity, acquisition cost, estimated market value, platform fees, payment fees, shipping, tax, handling, and other explicit scenario inputs independently of research prose.
acceptance_criteria: Every calculation input has a visible source or operator override and can be changed without rewriting collected observations or imported research.

title: Add candidate review states and notes
description: Add operator-owned interesting, watch, ignore, buy, and archived states plus timestamped collaborative notes while preserving decision history.
acceptance_criteria: State transitions and notes are authorized, persisted, attributable, and visible in history.

title: Build the opportunity decision workflow
description: Turn collected facts and imported research into operator-owned purchase decisions with review states, notes, deterministic economics, and sortable opportunity signals.
acceptance_criteria: Operators can classify candidates, record notes and assumptions, calculate transparent profit/ROI scenarios in application code, and sort/filter opportunities without treating model prose as arithmetic truth.

title: Harden verification and project documentation
description: Add focused automated tests, CI gates needed by the slice, Docker context hygiene, and reconcile README/setup instructions with actual functionality.
acceptance_criteria: Automated checks cover validation and normalization; frozen install, tests, typecheck, and production build pass; README claims and local setup are accurate; Docker build context excludes local/secrets artifacts.
close_reason: Added unit/integration tests, PostgreSQL CI migration gate, current pnpm pin, Docker context hygiene, non-root runtime healthcheck, PG18-correct Compose volume, accurate setup/status documentation, and successful production/container smoke tests.
